title: NYC Real Estate Photography & Drone Video — Carpio Media

texts_in_order.text: Residential Real Estate Photography & Drone Video in NYC

Carpio Media creates residential and luxury real estate photography, aerial drone video, and listing media for agents, brokers, developers, property managers, and homeowners. Based in Forest Hills, Queens, we serve properties throughout New York City, Long Island, Westchester, New Jersey, and Connecticut.

Each property is captured with a coordinated ground-and-air approach. Interior and exterior photography communicates the design and atmosphere of the space, while FAA-compliant aerial imagery adds location, scale, surrounding views, and neighborhood context.

Projects can include high-resolution listing photography, aerial photographs, cinematic drone video, property walkthroughs, and vertical social-media edits. The scope is planned around the property, the audience, and where the finished media will be published.
To request a quote, send the property address, preferred shoot date, approximate square footage, required deliverables, and intended listing or campaign launch date through the Contact page.
